sloka: उवाच एनम् स्मितम् कृत्वा रुद्रम् शूलधरम् हरिः ।दैवतैः मध्यमानो तु तत् पूर्वम् समुपस्थितम् ॥१-४५-२३॥
transliteration: uvāca enam smitam kṛtvā rudram śūladharam hariḥ ।daivataiḥ madhyamāno tu tat pūrvam samupasthitam ॥1-45-23॥

translations.english: Hari, smiling said to the tridentbearing Rudra "O Chief of celestial beings you were born the earliest among the devatas. Therefore, while churning the ocean whichever is produced first shall be offered to you. Considering it the first offering, O Lord accept this venom."
translations.hindi: जो जल के वेग से ऊपर को ) उछाले जाते थे, वे ऐसे जान पड़ते थे, मानों आकाश में बिजली चमकती हो और जल में उठे हुए सफेद-सफेद फेन जो इधर-उधर जगह-जगह छिंतरा गए थे
